mu_name_from: MODEL_FROST_MACE (MODEL_MACE + 16), loaded from Item/Mace_17.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1110). Ours is named Mace17 by the index-plus-one rule. Group 2 number 16 in OpenMU S6 Weapons.cs:198.
why_this_one: The 100-140 weapons MU has and this game lacked (the user, 2026-10-22: 'we need those low level items now', every class's but the Dark Lord's, then 'do next missing weapons for lower levels'): the second batch's mace, bow and staves.

stats.call_note: The Season 6 CreateWeapon: group, number, slot, skill, width, height, dropsFromMonsters, name, dropLevel, minimumDamage, maximumDamage, attackSpeed, durability, magicPower, levelRequirement, strength, agility, energy, vitality, then darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel, magicGladiatorClassLevel, darkLordClassLevel, summonerClassLevel, ragefighterClassLevel.
stats.class_level_note: The Muse Elf's alone: OpenMU's elfClassLevel 2. sim::fits asks Wearer::second (docs/game/second-class-gear.md).

stance_from: Width 1: one-handed, as the Elemental Mace.
sheet_from: Data/Item/socketelf_frostmace.OZJ (64x64, icy blue-silver with a red gem, mesh 0, 364 triangles), GRA (the grey ramp, mesh 1, 200) and bloodbone02 (16x16, red, mesh 2, 24), decoded from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py.
material_overrides_note: Its handle is gold and green painted on, which steel turned near-black in the studio (2026-10-22, against a MU-style render of its arm): painted_steel with a shallow cast grain.
glow_note: RenderPartObjectBody's MODEL_FROST_MACE arm (ZzzObject.cpp:7192-7198): the body with mesh 1 hidden, then meshes 1, 3 (none: it has three) and 2 RENDER_TEXTURE | RENDER_BRIGHT, added (ZzzBMD.cpp:1534) -- here both out of the bake, added.
held_loop_from: MuMain plays its action 0 always while held, at PLAYER_STOP_MALE's PlaySpeed (ZzzCharacter.cpp:10151-10155): 0.28 of a key a 25 Hz frame, 7 keys a second round its 8 keys, a loop of 8/7 s.
rig_note: Mace17.rig.json from export-rig --actions=all: 25 bones, one action of eight keys, the frost spikes turning, kept and played always (held_loop). Held, MuMain's sprites are ZzzCharacter.cpp:7842-7971 (fx/held_lights, to do).
